Hi all,
I'm trying to formalize Theorem 11.1 (The Hilbert Serre Theorem) from Atiyah and MacDonald's commutative algebra and I was wondering if there was some code already out there for it. The theorem wants (eventual polynomial behavior of coefficients of a rational power series of the form p / (1 - X)^d).
Thanks!
A PhD student of mine @Fangming Li (John) has fully formalised this result but I believe it's not in mathlib yet.
@Jujian Zhang and I have formalised the Hilbert-Serre Theorem and Hilbert polynomials of graded modules. The code is available in this repository: https://github.com/FMLJohn/HilbertPolynomial.

For the eventual polynomial behavior of coefficients of the power series expansion of p/(1-X)^d, the content is available in Mathlib4. See https://leanprover-community.github.io/mathlib4_docs/Mathlib/RingTheory/Polynomial/HilbertPoly.html.
But the Hilbert-Serre Theorem is not in Mathlib4 yet.
